scenes.title: Where does an agent keep what it learns about you?
scenes.caption: That is a choice. Here it is yours.
scenes.narration: An agent that remembers you has to keep that memory somewhere. With Hermes on Companion Hub, that somewhere is hardware you own.

scenes.title: Hermes
scenes.caption: The Hermes agent, with Companion Memory built in.
scenes.narration: This is Hermes, the Companion Memory edition.

scenes.caption: Opens straight into chat. Ctrl+D drops to the shell.
scenes.narration: Open it from the Hub and it drops you into chat. Press Control D when you want the shell for commands like hermes model.

shots.alt: The Hermes web terminal as installed from the Hub market: a welcome banner explaining that Ctrl+D leaves chat for the shell, and an empty prompt.

scenes.title: The model comes from your Hub
scenes.caption: Local first. A cloud key sits beside it, never in front.
scenes.narration: The model follows your Hub's inference settings. Add a cloud key in the Hub and it appears alongside the local model. It does not replace it.

scenes.title: Connect Companion Memory
scenes.caption: Active after the first restart.
scenes.narration: Memory is its own app. Install Companion Memory, create an A P I key in its settings, and paste it into the Hermes install dialog.

items.value: Paste into the Hermes install dialog

scenes.title: It says when it remembered
scenes.caption: Recall shows up beside the reply.
scenes.narration: Once Hermes recalls something for a message, it tells you. You see a line beside the reply saying how many memories it used.

scenes.title: Read-only intents become tools
scenes.caption: The server refuses the rest on its own.
scenes.narration: With memory connected, Hermes can call Companion's read-only intents as tools. Destructive or external ones are never registered, and the server refuses them anyway.

scenes.title: Hub tools are optional
scenes.caption: Separate from memory. Off unless you want them.
scenes.narration: Hub tools are a separate, optional connection. Memory works without them. Turn them on and Hermes can reach the platform and the apps you have installed.

scenes.title: What stays yours
scenes.caption: One agent, one memory, both on your machine.
scenes.narration: The agent runs in its own sandbox on your Hub, the memory is on your hardware, and the source is public.

scenes.cta: Install Hermes from the Hub market.
scenes.narration: Hermes, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.
